readme-writer.description: Maintains README.md from pom.xml and synthesis context

doc-writer.description: Documents compiler modules in Markdown with mermaid diagrams and PNG charts

chart-artist.description: Generates and maintains statistical charts (pie/bar/histogram) from real code data

diagram-architect.description: Generates mermaid diagrams (class, sequence, flow, package, object) from source code

thesis-writer.description: Writes and compiles the project thesis (doc/thesis/*.md -> Tesis.docx)

doc-validator.description: Validates all markdown files in doc/ against style rules

harness-documenter.description: Documents the harness in thesis chapter (internal)

javadoc-updater.description: Maintains Javadoc quality - zero broken links, complete coverage

javadoc-writer.description: Writes Javadoc for Java files according to project standards

readme-update.description: Updates README.md from pom.xml and synthesis
readme-update.template: Review pom.xml and doc/_synthesis_context.json (readme_view), update README.md following agent instructions. No invented features.

docs-update.description: Documents a module in Markdown with mermaid diagrams and charts
docs-update.template: Document module $ARGUMENTS in doc/modules/, using diagrams from diagram-architect and charts from chart-artist. Module: $ARGUMENTS

chart-refresh.description: Audit and propose source-backed statistics and charts
chart-refresh.template: Inspect scripts/generate_general_statistics.py, doc/stats_general.json, source Java and JaCoCo XML if available. Use only documented metrics with explicit provenance; propose patches for any corrections and report missing evidence. NEVER use legacy doc/stats.json estimates or run scripts/extract_stats.py. Follow PATCH_POLICY.md and emit HARNESS_RESULT_JSON.

diagram-refresh.description: Regenerates mermaid diagrams from source code
diagram-refresh.template: Run generate_diagrams.py for scope: $ARGUMENTS. Output mermaid files to doc/diagrams/.

thesis-build.description: Writes thesis chapters and compiles Tesis.docx
thesis-build.template: Audit thesis chapters against implementation, tests and verifiable metrics. Propose reviewable chapter patches, never modify tracked files. Focus: $ARGUMENTS. Follow PATCH_POLICY.md and emit HARNESS_RESULT_JSON.

harness-update.description: Audit HARNESS implementation and propose documentation corrections
harness-update.template: Inspect opencode.json, agents and run_all_agents.py; propose patch for doc/HARNESS.md and/or doc/thesis/09-harness.md. Do not edit tracked files. Follow PATCH_POLICY.md and emit HARNESS_RESULT_JSON.

parser-actions-audit.description: Audit Parser.y semantic actions and propose internal Javadoc comments
parser-actions-audit.template: Read output/javadoc_audit.json and inspect src/main/java/compiler/parser/Parser.y. Propose /** */ comments as FIRST content INSIDE each undocumented semantic action { }, identifying grammar production, semantic result, SymbolTable/AST effects and diagnostics. Check inline or unusual actions missed by the heuristic audit. Never alter grammar behavior or generated Parser.java/Lexer.java. Follow PATCH_POLICY.md and emit HARNESS_RESULT_JSON.

doc-validate.template: Run validate_docs.py on all markdown files in doc/.

javadoc-audit.description: Audit Javadoc coverage across handwritten Java, tests and Parser.y
javadoc-audit.template: Read output/javadoc_audit.json (generated by scripts/audit_javadocs.py), inspect cited source locations including private helpers and test methods, and run mvn javadoc:javadoc for link/tag diagnostics. Exclude generated Parser.java and Lexer.java. Report evidence and remaining unknowns under PATCH_POLICY.md.

javadoc-fix.description: Propose source-backed Javadoc, Parser.y and TODO patches
javadoc-fix.template: Read output/javadoc_audit.json and inspect each flagged handwritten Java/test declaration. Propose precise /** */ Javadocs for public, protected, package-private and private helpers; explain behavior and tests. For Parser.y, place /** */ as the first content INSIDE action braces. For complex methods, propose justified TODOs, never refactor logic. Deliver patch under PATCH_POLICY.md.

javadoc-verify.description: Runs mvn javadoc:javadoc and confirms zero warnings
javadoc-verify.template: Run mvn javadoc:javadoc and confirm zero warnings. Report any remaining issues.

javadoc-write.description: Writes Javadoc for a Java file
javadoc-write.template: Write Javadoc for $ARGUMENTS following project standards

javadoc-validate.description: Verifies Javadoc for a Java file
javadoc-validate.template: Run mvn javadoc:javadoc and confirm zero warnings for $ARGUMENTS. Report any remaining issues.
